description: This Java class 'BookUtils' contains utility methods related to 'Book' objects, primarily for combining the book title with its series information if applicable.

classes.name: BookUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for manipulating Book objects, including combining title and series info.

methods.name: combineTitleAndSeries
methods.description: Returns the combined title and series information of a book if the book has a series position; otherwise, returns the book's title.

methods.name: bookHasSeriesPosition
methods.description: Checks if the book has a non-null, positive series position.

methods.name: addSeriesToTitle
methods.description: Creates an Optional containing the book title appended with series position if both are non-null.
